reason: Not_comparable metric and ambiguous target outcome on PDF p. 3: the paper reports two 2 (OCD vs. control) x 2 (wiped vs. did not wipe) between-subjects ANOVAs replicating Zhong and Liljenquist (2006) Study 4—willingness to help (hand-wiping main effect F(1, 54) = 110.41, p < .001, η2 = .076) and moral emotions (hand-wiping main effect F(1, 54) = 341.10, p < .001, η2 = .150)—and neutral coding metadata cites both outcomes without uniquely selecting one apart from numerical agreement with shipped 0.076. Moreover, es_type_r requests partial eta-squared, which does not equal printed η2 in a 2 x 2 factorial ANOVA (F(1, 54) = 110.41 implies partial η2 = .672 and F(1, 54) = 341.10 implies partial η2 = .863), with no documented conversion.
